arguments.content:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import linregress
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Load data
water_temp = pd.read_csv('/root/data/water_temperature.csv')
climate = pd.read_csv('/root/data/climate.csv')
land_cover = pd.read_csv('/root/data/land_cover.csv')
hydrology = pd.read_csv('/root/data/hydrology.csv')

# 1. Trend Analysis
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = linregress(water_temp['Year'], water_temp['WaterTemperature'])
trend_result = pd.DataFrame({'slope': [slope], 'p-value': [p_value]})
trend_result.to_csv('/root/output/trend_result.csv', index=False)

# 2. Dominant Factor Analysis
# Merge data
df = water_temp.merge(climate, on='Year').merge(land_cover, on='Year').merge(hydrology, on='Year')

# Define categories
categories = {
    'Heat': ['AirTempLake', 'Shortwave', 'Longwave'],
    'Flow': ['Precip', 'Inflow', 'Outflow'],
    'Wind': ['WindSpeedLake'],
    'Human': ['DevelopedArea', 'AgricultureArea']
}

X_cols = [col for cols in categories.values() for col in cols]
X = df[X_cols]
y = df['WaterTemperature']

# Feature Importance using Random Forest
rf = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=1000, random_state=42)
rf.fit(X, y)

importances = rf.feature_importances_
feature_importance_df = pd.DataFrame({'feature': X_cols, 'importance': importances})

# Aggregate importance by category
category_importance = {}
for cat, cols in categories.items():
    category_importance[cat] = feature_importance_df[feature_importance_df['feature'].isin(cols)]['importance'].sum()

# Normalize to percentage
total_importance = sum(category_importance.values())
category_percentage = {k: v / total_importance for k, v in category_importance.items()}

# Find dominant factor
dominant_cat = max(category_percentage, key=category_percentage.get)
dominant_val = category_percentage[dominant_cat]

dominant_factor_df = pd.DataFrame({'variable': [dominant_cat], 'contribution': [dominant_val]})
dominant_factor_df.to_csv('/root/output/dominant_factor.csv', index=False)
